gate: Gate 2 supplementary project evidence; Gate 3 claim boundary only
unit: project record, not verified unique plant or enterprise
primary_sample: Activity exactly Manufacturing; destinations Mexico/Vietnam/Thailand; 2014-2022; all origins/types/statuses retained
counts: annual means use all fixed calendar years, including zero-count years; shares are pooled record-count shares within each period
deduplication: All records retained in primary. Noncontact exact collapse is sensitivity; type-and-parent-preserving core collapse is deliberately aggressive stress, not a true deduplicated series or bound.
parent_matching: NFKC plus whitespace and case normalization; exact Source_Country + Parent_Company + Destination_Country; no fuzzy aliases; positive history is observed project history, not proof of operation. Unmatched is not entry.
sector_scope: All native fDi sectors with Manufacturing activity. No claim of matching F03 six-sector ISIC universe.

source_groups.Other parents: all others, including Hong Kong and Singapore

amount_and_jobs: Not headline weights or production proxies. Vendor units unconfirmed; estimates frequent.
stats: Descriptive delivered-sample accounting, no tests, confidence intervals, causality or welfare estimates.
